description: Retrieve the full title and text content of a specific note in the NotebookLM Studio panel.

note_title.description: The title of the note to retrieve content for.

notebook_url.description: Optional NotebookLM URL. If not provided, uses the active notebook.

session_id.description: Optional Session ID to reuse an existing session.

name: note_get

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
